message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: Su (苏) engaged in fraudulent scheme: He pretended to supply cement, got money from Wang (汪) and others, used money to repay personal debts, provided fake delivery invoices, delivered only two trucks of cement (value 3.5万) but took 23万 from Wang. So that's fraud (诈骗) – specifically contract fraud, maybe fraud in business (诈骗). Also forging documents: he forged delivery invoices (伪造发货单). That's falsification of documents (伪造、变造公司票据/发货单). Could be "伪造、变造公司印章、票据" but here it's forging company delivery documents. So crime: fraud (诈骗) and forgery of business documents (伪造、变造发票/单据). In examples, they used "伪造、变造居民身份证" etc. For business documents, they used "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章". Here it's forging company documents, maybe "伪造、变造公司票据、发货单". Could be "伪造、变造发货单" which falls under "伪造、变造公司、企业、事业单位印章、票据". So answer: 诈骗;伪造、变造发货单 (伪造、变造公司票据). Also maybe "非法获取公民个人信息"? No. Also "非法经营" maybe? But main crimes: fraud and forgery.

Thus output: [罪名]诈骗;伪造、变造发货单<eoa>
